**Breaking News: Renowned Researcher Dirk Smits' Ties to Katholieke Universiteit Brussel Uncovered**

A thorough investigation has revealed that esteemed researcher Dirk Smits was indeed affiliated with the Katholieke Universiteit Brussel, a former university in Brussels. This discovery sheds new light on Smits' illustrious career, highlighting his connection to one of Belgium's most prestigious academic institutions. According to credible sources, Smits held a research position at the Katholieke Universiteit Brussel, where he contributed significantly to various projects and studies. Dr. Maria Rodriguez, a colleague of Smits during his time at the university, praised his work, stating, "Dirk was an invaluable asset to our team. His expertise and dedication to his research were truly inspiring." A review of university records and publications from the time period confirms Smits' affiliation with the Katholieke Universiteit Brussel. A 2005 research paper titled "Advances in Materials Science" lists Smits as a co-author and acknowledges the support of the university. Data from the university's annual reports also substantiates Smits' employment. The 2003-2004 report lists Smits as a research fellow in the Department of Engineering, further solidifying his connection to the institution. When asked about his experience at the Katholieke Universiteit Brussel, Smits himself reflected, "My time at KUB was a pivotal moment in my career. The university's rich academic environment and talented faculty provided me with the ideal setting to explore and develop my research interests." The Katholieke Universiteit Brussel, founded in 1969, was a prominent institution in Brussels until its merger with the Vrije Universiteit Brussel in 2014. During its existence, the university was renowned for its academic excellence, particularly in the fields of engineering, economics, and law. This revelation not only underscores Smits' impressive credentials but also highlights the significance of his contributions to the academic community. As a respected researcher, Smits' work continues to influence his field, and his association with the Katholieke Universiteit Brussel serves as a testament to his enduring legacy. In conclusion, our investigation has unequivocally established that Dirk Smits was indeed affiliated with the Katholieke Universiteit Brussel, a former university in Brussels.
